text: Who can do library duty friday? Mine fell through

I have a parent meeting after 3:30
could do lunch 12:45-1:30 if that works
Free friday. Which period
Lunch. 12:45 to 13:20 is the slot
I can do it if no one else. What does it involve, just sitting there?
Checking books out, reshelving the returns, and the sign-in sheet
Hiroshi, the 13th and the 20th are yours for the calligraphy display. Don't forget
Ok
First snow supposedly tomorrow. The kids in 3-2 were already asking if they can go out at lunch
They can't go out in the first snow, it turns to slush and then they come back soaked
I know. I told them that. They weren't interested
Ok chiaki 12:45 friday then. Kohei can you do the 4th period free slot on thursday to cover it
I'm not sure that's free, let me check
Thursday 4th is taken, I have 5-1 for the music swap. Sorry
Ok. I'll find someone
Thu 4th I'm free. I can do it
Thanks. That covers it
Hiroshi you're on the gym rota that week too
Not till the 5th
Ok 12:45 friday is me then
3-2 are going to be a nightmare if it snows at lunch though
Forecast says it holds off till after lunch
Hiroshi the calligraphy paper came in. It's in the cupboard by the copier, not the store room
Ok
[photo: car park with first flakes on the windscreens]
Ha, already
Tell 3-2 the same thing as Friday. Not outside even if it looks fine
Already said it twice. They're looking at me like I'm the problem
Sorry going back to the library thing, do I need to bring anything for the sign-in sheet or is it already in the room
In the drawer under the returns trolley
Thanks
Snow's sticking now. 3-2 are at the window, not at the lunch hall
Good
Anyone know if the gym is booked tomorrow after school or is that the basketball club again
Basketball. Thu is free
Thank you
Hiroshi, the fractions unit for 5-1, is the worksheet on the shared drive or did you print them out before
Nevermind found it
[photo: orange school glove on the 3rd floor stairs]
Whose is this. Has a name on it but it's rubbed off
Thu 4th, which room is 5-1 in for the fractions. 4-2 or still the old music room
4-2. They moved us back after the swap
Ok
Glove is probably 3-1, they had the same ones last year
Will check at the morning meeting
Glove is 3-1's. Mrs Ota confirmed. She'll send someone to pick it up
Good
Kohei if you want to help with the display on the 13th that's fine. Bring your own tape, the roll in the office is always empty
Ok. Is it the wall by the entrance again
Yes
Big sheets have to be up by the 12th. Rest can go up on the 13th
Ok thanks
3-2 asked again if it's going to snow at lunch on friday. I said ask the forecast
Hiroshi did you get the big sheets from the store room or do you need them from the office
Store room. I have them
Ok
Is there spare tape anywhere or do I just buy some
Buy it. The office roll went in the bin in September
Ok
3-1 came and got the glove. One of them said thank you to me like I'd made it
[photo: a child's drawing of a snowman wearing one orange glove]
Left on my desk. No idea whose
Hiroshi same worksheet for thursday 4th as monday or is there a new one
Same. 4-2 has rulers in the cupboard by the door if they didn't bring any
Thanks
Roads are black ice by the north gate. Walking round by the bike shed
Ok. Be careful on that path
It's fine. It's just slow
Taking the calligraphy paper to school now. Will leave the cupboard open
Bring the blue ink too, it's on the second shelf
